title: An open-source spec for orchestration: Symphony
summary: Learn how Symphony, an open-source spec for Codex orchestration, turns issue trackers into always-on agent systems—boosting engineering output and reducing context switching.
body: Learn how Symphony, an open-source spec for Codex orchestration, turns issue trackers into always-on agent systems—boosting engineering output and reducing context switching.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了名为Symphony的开源编排规范，专门用于Codex模型的任务流管理。该规范旨在将传统的问题追踪系统转化为持续运行的AI Agent系统，通过标准化接口减少工程开发中的上下文切换，提升自动化开发效率。

aiReview.reasonZh: Symphony作为一种开源编排规范，为解决AI Agent在工程化落地中的上下文切换问题提供了新思路。
